_note: Named NON-pinned MuSiQue evaluation sets (issue #56, ADR 0037). A named set is selected explicitly with --eval-set <name> on components/decomposer/run_decomposer.py and scripts/musique_decompositions_evaluator.py; without that flag both scripts behave exactly as before and assert the ADR 0007 pinned 600 (the decomposer) or nothing (the evaluator). The pinned 600 stays the headline evaluation set; a named set here is a population for offline resampling (scripts/resample_eval_sets.py), not a replacement. Each set is defined by a source file under data_root (datasets.<source_key> in configs/paths.json) and is asserted BY ID: the loaded/evaluated ids must be exactly the source file's ids whose answerable_field is true, and their count must equal expected_total, so a changed source file is a refusal rather than a silently different population. Per-hop counts are derived from the ids (the '<n>hop' prefix) and recorded in metrics; they are not separately configured.

musique_dev_full._note: Every answerable question of the MuSiQue v1.0 answerable dev split: 2,417 rows (1,252 / 760 / 405 at 2 / 3 / 4 hops, counted 2026-10-14 from the file). The pinned 600 of ADR 0007 are a subset. Built for the sampling-variance study, issue #56.
